name: Aws Agentic Ai
summary: AWS Bedrock AgentCore comprehensive expert for deploying and managing AI agents at scale. Essential when user mentions AgentCore, agent runtime, agent registry, agent evaluation, MCP gateway, deploy agent, register MCP server, discover agents, evaluate agent quality, agent credentials, or wants to build, deploy, catalog, or monitor AI agents on AWS.

name: Aws Cdk Development
